common: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset: professional conceptual illustration for one column of a Korean corporate architecture presentation. Refined flat vector-like editorial art, dark navy outlines with consistent medium stroke, white and pale blue opaque object faces, muted sage green highlights, small restrained cyan details. No gradient or fake shadows, no glossy 3D, no realism, no enclosing square. True transparent background. Square canvas with about 12% generous empty margin. Readable small, few large objects, tasteful corporate style consistent across three illustrations. Do not draw text, letters, logos, or watermarks.
